$comment: Demo character proving the retarget path end to end. The only difference from Blaze and Titan is the `model` key: with it, CharacterLoader loads the GLB, retargets the shared clip set onto its skeleton, and plays real clips instead of the procedural poser. Delete the `model` line and this character falls back to the box rig with identical fight behaviour — that is the whole point of the ladder.
name: Proto
